documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported FY19 consolidated revenue growth of 3% (13% adjusted for billing methodology changes) and an EBITDA margin expansion of nearly 400 basis points driven by volume growth, benign raw material prices, and higher international contributions. Management stated that domestic demand was temporarily impacted by severe weather in Q4, while international revenues crossed the $20 million milestone. For FY20, the company expects to incur regular capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore, implement price hikes in the second half due to higher milk prices, and deliver double-digit growth with margin expansion. Vadilal Industries reported robust financial performance for Q3 and nine months of FY19, driven by strong growth in both domestic and international segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double-digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management stated they expect another good year in FY20.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic revenues declined by 7% on a reported basis due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending winter and impacting ice cream consumption.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic revenues declined by 7% on reported basis but increased by 3% on adjusted, like-to-like comparison basis. Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues grew by 54% in FY19 and crossed the $20 million milestone, driven by strong demand from the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19. International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

capex_expansion.claim: The company has committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that no major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY20 is stated at approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY19 is around Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year driven by volume growth, benign raw material prices, and larger international contributions.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, driven by U.S. operations.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Other operating expenses were kept under tight control and remained almost unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: However, we have kept a tight control on other operating expenses that remained almost unchanged.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Stable costs are covered till Q2 based on raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business saw weakness due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending winter till the end of March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

management_commitments.claim: Management will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels now.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.claim: The company will continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will continue to invest in production capacity, technology, brand and distribution.
management_commitments.quote: Will continue to invest in production capacity, technology, brand and distribution

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
